name: Right panel
responsibility: Stands beside the picture on every Diagram reading and says what is selected, or what is open while nothing is, over what can be done and the Legend
description: A selection never moves the picture, because the panel always holds its place. Beside what it explains it lists the flows and walkthroughs that concern the open module. One click opens a door, and a click with Ctrl selects it. A door's tip shows up to eight endpoints, and About keeps the whole list. Every tab that shows panel rows composes them from this module's Row, Body, Head, Section and Rows.
